scope: First 473 genes completing all 30 required repetitions in frozen eligible-manifest order; not a random transcriptome sample and not valid for transcriptome-wide prevalence claims.
restart_selection: lowest model-specific stationary NLL among completed neural restarts
guardrails: Ambiguous genes are not force-routed for formal kinetic interpretation.
K3 support is for an effective sequential higher-order representation, not a unique microscopic topology.
Cross-gene BS/BF patterns do not establish a dominant regulatory strategy.
Full-data CDF metrics are descriptive goodness-of-fit diagnostics, not held-out validation.
